name: Chouno Haru
source: Shinsuke's fiancée and a fellow teacher at Usagino high school. She has a terrible personality and often threatens Shinsuke with violence. Shinsuke determines to change her personality to one more fitting of a bridal candidate or abandon her for someone who does. A fact she is aware of and frustrated by.
